notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary attribute handle/name lookup across connection, membership, inherited object-class definitions, invalid-input, and cross-federate identity boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador API and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM model, endpoint, logical-time choice, and callback configuration. It verifies inherited base-attribute handle stability, derived-attribute lookup, standard name round trips, and standard invalid-name, invalid-class, invalid-attribute, and not-defined exceptions without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attribute handle/name lookup across lifecycle and inherited object-class boundaries
